title: Trade Partners and Components on a Phone
description: Report: on a phone, opening Trade in the action phase hid a trade partner, several owned components were hidden, and components did not say what they do. Root cause: both menus open upward from the action bar as a popover capped at 55vh, but the bar itself is about 340 px tall and sits 52 px above the bottom, so the popover's top (its heading and the first partner or the first components) ran past the top of the screen, where nothing can scroll it back. Opening Components also focused its first row, whose hover panel then rendered inside the bar on phones and pushed the bar and the menu further up. Rows showed only the engine label ("use codex", a bare leader name). Fix: on phones an open menu is a sheet from just below the game header down to the bar's bottom edge (measured while open), with a sticky title and a 44 px Close; the hover panel is not shown while a menu is open; rows and Open buttons are at least 44 px. Each component row now spells out its printed name, kind and owner, timing, cost and full rules text, looked up from the content catalog by option id (relics added to the generated catalog); option ids are unchanged. Before shots were taken with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before on the base commit and are committed under before/; npm run screenshots -- CQ regenerates the after shots and asserts every partner name, Open button and component row is inside the viewport, not covered (elementFromPoint), at least 44 px tall, and that each component row has rules text. 390x664 is a 390 px phone with Safari's toolbars showing. At 390x844 the 6-player trade list still just fitted before the fix (it covered the game header); the hidden partner reproduces at 360x740 and 390x664. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server, not captured engine states.
